jobs.title: Clinical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're a team of engineers, data scientists, clinical research professionals, and clinicians who believe every patient deserves access to the best possible treatment options, no matter who they are, where they live, or where they receive their care.

We help large health systems become better at research. Our AI-powered platform makes sense of complex clinical trial criteria and every patient's medical record. It puts that intelligence in the hands of principal investigators, research staff, and care teams, so they can identify eligible patients faster and bring research directly to where patients already are.

That same intelligence layer supports research administrators and leaders managing studies across sites. The result: PIs run more efficient, higher-enrolling studies. Research administrators gain visibility and control across a growing, distributed portfolio. Clinicians and caregivers receive transparent, timely insights to guide treatment decisions. And more patients, regardless of zip code, gain access to the trial that might be right for them.

We're breaking down the barriers between patients and the research that could change their care.

About the Role

The Clinical Solutions Engineer role is a full-time, remote position with company headquarters in San Mateo, CA. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of clinical research operations, software engineering, and customer success. You will help health-system research teams successfully deploy, adopt, and expand Lindy’s clinical trial platform—from initial workflow discovery and onboarding through go-live and ongoing use.

You will work directly with principal investigators, clinical research coordinators, clinical trials office leadership, and health-system IT and data teams. You will translate real clinical workflows into clear product and technical requirements, configure deployments, develop training materials, run demonstrations and office hours, and help customers incorporate Lindy into their daily research operations.

When something is not working as expected, you will be the first technical and clinical investigator. You will reproduce problems, inspect application behavior, query data, trace APIs and data flows, and use modern coding tools and agents to diagnose issues, build internal tools, and implement or prototype appropriately scoped fixes. When a problem requires changes from product or core engineering, you will turn it into a precise, evidence-backed escalation with the affected workflow, expected behavior, technical findings, and customer impact already established.

You will also coordinate implementation workstreams across customer, product, clinical, integration, and engineering teams; maintain operating cadences with research leadership; surface risks and dependencies; and turn recurring customer needs into scalable product improvements, documentation, and playbooks.

This role is ideal for someone who began their career in oncology clinical research, developed real software-engineering ability, and now wants to combine both disciplines to improve how clinical trials reach patients.

Qualifications

3+ years of oncology clinical research operations experience as a Clinical Research Coordinator, Lead CRC, Clinical Research Nurse, or comparable site-level operator.
Hands-on experience pre-screening patients against oncology protocol eligibility criteria and managing a portfolio of studies across the clinical trial lifecycle.
At least 1 year of professional software engineering experience, with approximately 1.5+ years preferred, building, shipping, and debugging software used by others.
Proficiency in Python and SQL, along with working knowledge of APIs, application logs, data pipelines, Git, testing, and modern software-development practices.
Ability to investigate technical problems independently, distinguish product, data, configuration, and user-workflow failures, and communicate actionable findings to engineers.
Fluency with clinical research systems and workflows, including CTMS, eRegulatory, EDC, patient pre-screening, study activation, accrual, amendments, monitoring, and closeout.
Experience creating training materials and onboarding or training clinical research users.
Experience managing multi-workstream projects where you owned the outcome and timeline without directly controlling every dependency.
Ability to translate effectively among clinical users, research administrators, engineers, data teams, and health-system IT stakeholders.
Comfortable leading live demonstrations, explaining product output and limitations, and fielding difficult questions from clinicians and research leadership.
Preferred:
Experience with Epic or another major EHR, FHIR, HL7, C-CDA, APIs, data warehouse extracts, or healthcare software integrations.

That same intelligence layer supports research administrators and leaders managing studies across sites. The result: PIs run more efficient, higher-enrolling studies. Research administrators gain visibility and control across a growing, distributed portfolio. Clinicians and caregivers receive transparent, timely insights to guide treatment decisions. We're breaking down the barriers between patients and the research that could change their care.

The Clinical Solutions Engineer role is a full-time, remote position with company headquarters in San Mateo, CA. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of clinical research operations, software engineering, and customer success. You will help health-system research teams successfully deploy, adopt, and expand Lindy’s clinical trial platform—from initial workflow discovery and onboarding through go-live and ongoing use.

You will work directly with principal investigators, clinical research coordinators, clinical trials office leadership, and health-system IT and data teams. You will translate real clinical workflows into clear product and technical requirements, configure deployments, develop training materials, run demonstrations and office hours, and help customers incorporate Lindy into their daily research operations.

You will reproduce problems, inspect application behavior, query data, trace APIs and data flows, and use modern coding tools and agents to diagnose issues, build internal tools, and implement or prototype appropriately scoped fixes. This role is ideal for someone who began their career in oncology clinical research, developed real software-engineering ability, and now wants to combine both disciplines to improve how clinical trials reach patients.

Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking an organized, creative, and client-focused Video Project Coordinator to lead and manage our marketing video product line. This role will oversee video projects from initial concept through final delivery, working closely with clients, internal partners, and external production vendors.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and project coordinator who can develop compelling video concepts, write effective scripts, coordinate production resources, manage vendor costs, and oversee a high volume of projects while maintaining quality, timelines, and budgets.

Key Responsibilities

Manage the day-to-day operations and continued growth of the company’s marketing video product line.
Collaborate with clients and business partners to understand their goals, target audiences, messaging, and creative vision.
Develop video concepts, creative briefs, treatments, and storyboards.
Write clear, engaging video scripts that align with client objectives and brand guidelines.
Coordinate with external video production vendors, including videographers, editors, voiceover artists, and other creative professionals.
Manage video vendor costs, negotiate pricing, and ensure projects remain within approved budgets.
Manage the production process from pre-production and filming through editing, revisions, and final delivery.
Review video footage and edits to ensure quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and alignment with the approved creative direction.
Track and project manage a high volume of video projects simultaneously.
Establish project timelines, communicate deadlines, and provide regular updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
Manage client feedback and revision requests while keeping projects on schedule and within scope.
Develop project quotes and cost estimates based on production requirements, timelines, locations, talent, equipment, and editing needs.
Maintain accurate project documentation, budgets, schedules, vendor costs, and production records.
Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, vendor relationships, turnaround times, and overall product quality.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, film, media production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience managing video production, creative services, marketing, or multimedia projects.
Strong scriptwriting, storytelling, and creative-development skills.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders at the same time.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
Experience working directly with clients and translating business objectives into creative concepts.
Ability to develop accurate project scopes, quotes, and production estimates.
Experience managing vendor relationships, pricing, and production costs.
Familiarity with video production processes, including pre-production, filming, post-production, editing, and final delivery.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in an agency, digital marketing, media, or client-services environment.
Experience managing external video production vendors and freelancers.
Familiarity with video editing software and production equipment.
Knowledge of video marketing strategies for websites, social media, paid advertising, and other digital platforms.
Experience developing scalable video products or production workflows.

What Success Looks Like

The Video Project Coordinator will consistently deliver high-quality video projects that meet client objectives, remain within scope and budget, and are completed on time. This individual will also help strengthen our video product offering by improving processes, controlling vendor costs, expanding production capabilities, and creating an excellent experience for clients and partners.
